name: Fab
title: Fab
summary: The floating + button for a screen's one main create action, with the pull-to-refresh indicator and the snackbar that sits above the tab bar.
whenToUse: Use the FAB for the single most common create action on a list screen: New note on Saved.
Use pull to refresh on feeds that change from the server: Listen episodes, ISM Radio schedules.
Use the snackbar to confirm an action and offer Undo (note deleted, verse saved).
whenNotToUse: Do not use a FAB on reading screens, settings or anywhere with a blue primary button already.
Do not use the snackbar for errors that need attention; use an inline Alert.

anatomy.description: All three are placed inside `.ap-screen`, which is `position: relative`.

props.name: 'aria-label'
props.description: Names the action; the icon is always +, so there is no visible text. Required, e.g. "New note".

props.name: icon
props.description: Replace the + icon. Keep it +; only change it for a different create glyph.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the action, since the icon is always +: "New note". Required.

props.name: lifted
props.description: Move up above a visible snackbar.

props.name: placement
props.description: Absolute inside the screen (`absolute`, 16dp from the end and 16dp above `bottomOffset`) or in the normal flow (`static`).

props.name: bottomOffset
props.description: Height of what the FAB must clear: the tab bar (including safe area) and the mini player. Added to the 16dp margin.

variants.notes: 56px, Horizon Blue, 16px from the right, 16px above the tab bar
moves up while a snackbar shows
white 40px disc, spinning blue arc, under the app bar

states.universal: See rules/states.md for the seven required states and their hooks.

rules: One FAB per screen, and it is the screen's one Horizon Blue primary.
The icon is always +; the action is named in `aria-label`, not in visible text.
The FAB never covers the tab bar or the mini player; lift it with `.ap-fab-lifted` when a snackbar appears.
Snackbar: one line, one text action in `--blue-on-dark`, 44px tall action. Hide after 5s (8s with Undo).
Pull to refresh only on lists that fetch new data; show a short line of what is happening.
Feed rows (`.ap-ep`) use a 56px image, title 15/600, meta line and a 36px play button.

accessibility: `aria-label` on the FAB names the action ("New note").
Snackbar and refresh indicator use `role="status"`; never move focus to them.
Offer Undo somewhere else as well (the item's menu), as the snackbar disappears.
Provide a Refresh command for people who cannot pull (in More or via keyboard).
Reduced motion: no spin, show the static arc and the text.
content: Snackbar: past tense + verb: "Note deleted" + "Undo", "Verse saved" + "View".
